source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 iunie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Metodie, Episcopul Patarelor»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Μεθόδιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Πατάρων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. It is plainly the same man: the hieromartyr bishop of Patara, killed with a knife by a servant set on him by the Origenists he had driven back. The page prints no year in its own narrative, saying only «έζησε κατά τον 6ο μ.Χ. αιώνα», and then quotes S. Eustratiades against itself — that he flourished at the end of the third and the beginning of the fourth century, that according to Jerome and the historian Socrates he was bishop not of Patara but of Olympus in Lycia and afterwards of Tyre, that by another opinion he was bishop of Philippi in Macedonia, and that he was martyred at Chalcis in Syria under Diocletian. Because the page holds two irreconcilable datings and vouches for neither, no `dates` object is proposed here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge Sfinţite Mucenice Metodie, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Metodie, Episcopul Patarelor, glasul 4; the text is the common of a hieromartyr, printed for him.

english.text: Having become a sharer of the apostles' ways and a successor to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, an ascent to contemplation. Therefore, rightly dividing the word of truth, and contending for the faith even unto blood, O Hieromartyr Methodius, intercede with Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Ὡς στύλος ἀκλόνητος, τῆς Ἐκκλησίας Χριστοῦ, καὶ λύχνος ἀείφωτος τῆς οἰκουμένης σοφέ, ἐδείχθης Μεθόδιε· ἔλαμψας ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, διὰ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, ἔλυσας τῶν εἰδώλων, τὴν σκοτόμαιναν μάκαρ, διὸ ἐν παρρησίᾳ Χριστῷ, πρέσβευε σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχύ προκατάλαβε — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Μεθόδιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Πατάρων», and it names him

english.text: You were shown, O wise Methodius, an unshaken pillar of the Church of Christ and an ever-shining lamp of the whole world; you gave light to the world by your martyrdom, and you broke the darkness of the idols, O blessed one. Therefore intercede boldly with Christ, that we may be saved.
